doc.title: Ron Carter interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 17, 1999

title: Miles Smiles and developing music on the bandstand
summary: Carter says few songs were developed live before being recorded, including those on Miles Smiles.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: The thing I remember about that record was that we had a chance to develop that music on the bandstand. Most of the recorded sounds were just played on the record. Of maybe the 20 records we made, maybe 5 or 8 of them small group records, and maybe 7 songs a record, there was probably 50 songs, maybe 8 or 9 of them got played live to really develop them, and I’m sure the songs on that record didn’t really get the development that I wish they could have had.
